999008199.text: すごいよレスナちゃーん！
わわっ、ほのかちゃん！

さっきの、ボールがドーンって大きくなったのも
錬金術なんだよね！？　すごいすごーい！

localizations.en: That thing with the ball getting all big—that was alchemy too, right?! That was so cool!

999008199.text:
ありがとう、ほのかちゃん！　錬金術は夢の力でね、
あれの他にもできることがいっぱいあって――

localizations.en: Thanks, Honoka! Alchemy is the power of dreams, and there's so much more it can do besides that—

999008199.text:
錬金術……まさかあんなことができるなんて！
本当にすごい……！　おもしろい！

localizations.en: Alchemy... I had no idea it could do something like that! It's incredible...! Amazing!

999008199.text:
でしょでしょ～？
錬金術がほめられると、気分がいいですな～

localizations.en: Right? Right? When people praise alchemy, it feels great!

999008199.text:
レスナちゃん、すっごく嬉しそう。
錬金術、大好きだもんね

localizations.en: Resna looks so happy. She really loves alchemy.

999008199.text:
姉様もはしゃいでるわ。
得意気な姉様も素敵

localizations.en: Alvina's excited too. She looks wonderful when she's proud of herself.

999008199.text: ヴァレリア、あんたどこ行ってたのよ

localizations.en: Valeria, where'd you run off to?

999008199.text:
ちょっと見回り。なんだかさっきから
視線を感じる気がするのよね……魔物とは別の……

localizations.en: I just had a look around. I felt eyes on us... And it was not monsters...

999008199.text: 例の、悪の組織かしら？

localizations.en: Could it be that evil organization?

999008199.text:
悪の組織～？
何それ、僕たちに失礼じゃない？

localizations.en: Evil organization? What's that supposed to mean? That's not a nice thing to call your saviors, don't you think?

999008199.text:
迎えに来たよ。
みんな、無事なようで何よりだ

localizations.en: We came to get you. Good to see everyone's safe.

999008199.text:
イェルカ、シトリン！
視線の正体は、あんたらだったのね！

localizations.en: Jelka, Citrine! So it was the two of you I sensed!

999008199.text:
えぇっ！？
どうしてここにイェルカとシトリンがいるのさ！

localizations.en: What?! Why are Jelka and Citrine here?!

999008199.text:
世界を渡っちゃったお前さんたちを迎えに来たのさ。
錬金術ができないここじゃ、自力で帰れないだろ？

localizations.en: We're here to bring you back to your world. It's pretty hard to get back without the power of alchemy, isn't it?

999008199.text:
……！　それなら、私たちがヴィーナス諸島に
来たのは、あなたたちパルメ族の仕業なんですか？

localizations.en: ...! Does that mean you Palme are the ones who brought us to Venus Island in the first place?

999008199.text:
ん～、まあその辺りの事情は、
おいおい説明するよ。めんどくさいからね

localizations.en: Well, we'll explain all that later. It's a pain to get into right now.

999008199.text:
さ、早く帰ろ。別に急がなきゃ帰れない訳じゃないけど
僕たちも暇じゃないからね

localizations.en: Come on, let's head back. It's not like we're short on time, but we're not exactly keen to stay.

999008199.text:
レスナ、お迎えが来たの？
あの人たちは、レスナたちの仲間？

localizations.en: You have guests, Resna? Are they your companions?

999008199.text:
仲間、ではないかな……
でも、助けに来てくれたみたい

localizations.en: I wouldn't call them companions... But they are here to help.

999008199.text:
帰っちゃうの……？　レスナちゃんとアルビちゃんと
一緒に、フェス出たかったなぁ……

localizations.en: You're leaving...? I wanted to be in the festival with you and Alvie...

999008199.text: わ、私も！　みんなと一緒にフェスに出たい――

localizations.en: Me too! I want to be in the festival with everyone—

999008199.text:
迎えに来てくれてありがとうございます。
でも、時間の猶予があるのなら、まだ帰れません！

localizations.en: Thank you for coming to get us. But if it's not urgent, I would like to take care of something first!

999008199.text:
……どうして？　
みんな、元の世界に帰りたいんじゃないの？

localizations.en: You've got other priorities? For real?

999008199.text: 何か、帰れない理由でもあるのかい？

ちょっと、変な誤解は粋じゃないよ？
二人とも、この世界のことを色々教えてくれて――

localizations.en: Hey, don't get the wrong idea. These two taught us all about this world—

999008199.text:
とりあえずさぁ、僕たちの任務は、
一刻も早くみんなを元の世界に帰すことなんだよね

localizations.en: Look, we were tasked to get you home as soon as possible.

999008199.text:
帰らないって言うなら……
その理由になっている人たちをちょっと眠らせないと

localizations.en: If you won't cooperate... then we'll have to put those keeping you here to sleep for a bit.

999008199.text:
……っ！　つ、強そうな人たち……
きっと只者じゃない……！

localizations.en: ...! Th-they look strong... They're definitely not ordinary people...!

999008199.text:
怖いけど、でも……！
レスナちゃんたちを傷つけるなら、許さないです！

localizations.en: I'm scared, but even so...! If you're going to hurt Resna and the others, I won't let you!

999008199.text:
ふーん、僕たちと戦おうって？　いーよ。君たちは
未知の存在だ。「管理」の前にまず「調査」といこうか

localizations.en: Oh? We're doing this again? Fine by me. It's not like we even know you. So before we "manage" you, we'll carry out a little "investigation" first.

999008199.text:
粋じゃないかもしれないが、
ちょっと大人しくなってもらおうか

localizations.en: It may not be chic, but I might have to get you to quiet down for a bit.

999008199.text:
そ、そんなことさせません！
一度落ち着いて話すためにも……

localizations.en: If we could just calm down and talk this through...

999008199.text:
この世界で鍛えたアタシたちの女神力を
見せてやる！

localizations.en: We'll show you the goddess power we've acquired in this world!
